---
title: Vendor Report
description: One-page overview of vendor performance, health and operations — KPIs, status and level distribution, trends, city performance, onboarding funnel and watch lists.
---

## Overview

**Sidebar:** Vendors → Performance → **Vendor Report** (`/vendors/vendor-report`)

A comprehensive overview of vendor performance, health and operations for a selected period.

## Period selector

Top right: **7 Days**, **30 Days** (default), **90 Days** or **Custom** date range, plus a refresh button.

## KPI cards

| Card | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Active Vendors** | Vendors who took an order in the last 10 days. |
| **Pickup Rate** | Picked-up vs. inbound orders (e.g. "X of Y inbound"). |
| **Activation Rate** | Share of vendors activated. |
| **Completion Rate** | Share of orders completed. |
| **Vendor Fail Rate** | Share of orders failed by vendors. |
| **Avg Score** | Average vendor score out of 100 (see Leaderboard). |
| **SLA Violations** | Count of SLA breaches in the period. |
| **Total Credits** | Total credits held by vendors. |
| **Pending Payments** | Amount pending, with the number of vendors. |

## Charts and sections

| Section | What it shows |
| --- | --- |
| **Vendor Status Distribution** | Donut of all vendors by status — live, barred, hold, rejected, pending — with counts and %. |
| **Vendor Level Distribution** | Vendors per performance level. |
| **Daily Order Trend** | Orders per day over the period. |
| **City-wise Performance** | Performance by city. |
| **Top Failure Reasons** | Most common order failure reasons. |
| **Pickup Turnaround Time** | Pickup TAT distribution. |
| **Onboarding Funnel** | Applications → In Progress → Approved → Live. |
| **Top Performers** / **Needs Improvement** | Best and weakest vendors. |
| **Low Credit Vendors** | Vendors with under 100 credits (name, phone, credits) with a **View all** link to the Low Credit screen. |
| **Most Flagged Vendors** | Vendors with the highest flag counts. |
| **Trust & Safety** — **Stuck in Onboarding** | Vendors stuck in progress for 7+ days. |
| **Vendor SLA Breakdown** | SLA violations per vendor. |

Sections show "No data" when there is nothing for the selected period.

<Callout kind="tip">
Use this page for weekly vendor reviews: start with the KPI cards, then work through **Needs Improvement**, **Most Flagged** and **Stuck in Onboarding** for follow-ups.
</Callout>
